title: fix(app-shell): a deep link to an object read by name always leaves the splash (objectui#13052)
body:
Fixes #13052
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A deep link to an object outside the app's package (`/apps/APP/OBJECT`) reads that object by name through the app's object scope. A served refusal used to leave that scope unsettled for good, and the first-paint gate drew `LoadingScreen` with no exit. Now every by-name scope read ends in a state the route draws inside the shell.

- **A definite refusal is an answer** (ruling 1). `MetadataProvider`'s by-name read (`readItem`) classes `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` as an answer beside the plain absence. The name lands in `missing`, the scope settles, and the scope names the refusal per name. The route draws the existing "Object Not Found" view with one new sentence, `console.objectView.objectPackageDisabled`, in all ten packs. `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` draws "Object Not Found" as before. `isMetaItemAbsentError` is untouched and still answers only `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
- **The first-paint gate always has an exit** (ruling 2). A failed by-name read (5xx, network drop, a 4xx whose code this build does not know) is recorded once as `failed` on the scope entry. The read bumps once. `settled` stays false, so `useObjectPresence` still reads `unknown`, as the objectui#13009 pins require. Once nothing else is in flight, the scope read reports the name in `failed`. `appObjectScope.ts` counts a failed route read as done, so the splash lifts. The route slot then draws a failed-read state with Retry ("Couldn't load records" plus the generic load-error sentence and `common.retry`, all existing keys).
- **No retry loop.** A name marked `failed` is skipped by later `readObjectScope` calls, so the re-render that the failure causes asks nothing. Retry calls `invalidate('object', NAME)`, which drops the failed mark and the adapter's entry, so the next render asks exactly once. `refresh()` and a scope refetch also re-ask. This changes one objectui#13009 pin. Before, an incidental later read re-asked a failed name. Now only Retry, `invalidate` or `refresh` does. The pin is updated to say so and to drive `invalidate`.
- **Page routes** (`page/:pageName`): if a bound object's read fails, the page route also stops waiting and draws the same failed state.

### Where the outcome travels

`readObjectScope`'s declared return type lives in `@object-ui/react`, which is outside this card's file surface. Two fields carry the outcome beside that shape: `failed` (names) and `refused` (name to code). The producer is `MetadataProvider` and the reader is `appObjectScope.ts`, both in `@object-ui/app-shell`. They use a package-local hand-off type that is not exported. A provider without these fields (a test double, a host's own) reads as having none, which is the behaviour before this card.

`ConsoleObjectViewProps` is a ruled, pinned shape (`ObjectView.consoleProps.types.test.tsx`), so it is not widened. The not-found view moves into a module-level `ObjectNotFoundState` in `ObjectView.tsx`. `ObjectView` draws it for an absence, and the console route draws it with `packageDisabled` for the refusal. Nothing is added to the package entry: no export, prop or type member.

## Pins

New: `MetadataProvider.scopeRefusal-13052.test.tsx` uses a REAL `ObjectStackAdapter` through a fake `fetch`. `AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052.test.tsx` uses the real `MetadataProvider` under the real `AppContent`.

- (a) `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` in the flat body (the server's today) and in the wrapped `{error:{code}}` body. The scope settles and names the refusal. The route leaves the splash and draws `object-package-disabled` inside the console layout. One by-name read.
- (b) CONTROL: `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` draws `object-not-found` and names no refusal.
- (c) 503 and a network drop draw `route-object-read-failed` inside the shell, with one read and none on re-render. Retry asks exactly once more. Served, it renders the object. Failing again, it draws the failed state again, one read per click.
- (d) `404` with an unknown code (`SOME_FUTURE_REFUSAL`) draws the failed state.
- CONTROL: a served object renders normally, read by name once.

Ablation (`ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP mode, run at `fab9fb8416`). Each restore was proven by blob hash: after restore the blob equals HEAD (`08bda91cec30`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- A: drop the refusal classification (refusal read as failed). The three (a) tests go red. (c) and (d) stay green: a refusal then draws the failed state, so it does not hang.
- B: restore the old failed branch (`names.delete` and no bump, i.e. the hang). All nine (c) and (d) tests go red. (a) stays green.

## Verification (final HEAD `fab9fb8416`)

- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` (closure built first with `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`): exit 0.
- vitest, 41 files (470 tests) passed. They cover the new and edited pins, every test naming `readObjectScope` / `appObjectScope` / `useObjectPresence`, the AppContent scope, splash and page-route suites, the ObjectView props pin plus two ObjectView suites, the product-neutral ratchet, and 16 i18n pack-wide suites (key parity, de quote census, console namespace and more).
- `de-quote-pairing-3876` counts the new de sentence's paired quote span: census 90 to 91, recorded in the test like its predecessors.
- Pre-tsc battery (`check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`): exit 0 each. `check:spec-floors`: exit 1 `no-artifact` (it needs a whole-workspace build), recorded and not acted on, as the dispatch said.
- eslint over the 18 changed .ts/.tsx files (inline config honored, as each package's `lint` runs it): 0 errors.
- NOT MEASURED: the full `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/i18n/` directories (the dispatch bars whole-directory runs on the shared lock) and the other ObjectView suites. These are declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The `failed` / `refused` hand-off rides beside `@object-ui/react`'s `readObjectScope` return type. If another provider should honour it, the place to declare it is that contract (`packages/react`, outside this surface). Carrier: none named.
- Behaviour change for other scope readers (sidebar `requiresObject` gates, `useObjectPresence`): a failed name now stays `unknown` until Retry, `refresh` or `invalidate`, instead of being re-asked by the next incidental render.
